en.name: Wolf's Frenzy
en.description: Disappear into the clouds, then reappear in front of up to 5 targets with single attacks, confusing your foes.
en.command: {KeyBind:Dash} + {KeyBind:Kick} {KeyBind:MoveBack} to evade backward Can be added to a Quick Slot Can be used with your cestus
tooltip: Attack damage 1653% x1, max 5 hits
Evades backwards if there are no enemies to target. No collision while evading backwards.
29.33% damage in PvP only
